# IntentBondFactory

## IntentBondFactory
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/intent-system/src/contracts/IntentBondFactory.sol)

**Inherits:**
ProtocolAccessManaged

**Title:**
IntentBondFactory

Factory contract that creates individual bond contracts for each solver

Each solver gets their own bond contract for complete isolation


### State Variables
#### SUMMER_TOKEN_DECIMALS
The number of decimals for the Summer token


```solidity
uint256 public constant SUMMER_TOKEN_DECIMALS = 18
```


#### summerToken
The Summer token used for all bonds


```solidity
address public immutable summerToken
```


#### intentHandler

```solidity
address public intentHandler
```


#### oracle
The address of the price oracle used to value Summer token bonds


```solidity
address public oracle
```


#### solverBonds
Mapping of solver addresses to their bond contracts


```solidity
mapping(address => address) public solverBonds
```


#### allBonds
Array of all created bond contracts


```solidity
address[] public allBonds
```


### Functions
#### constructor


```solidity
constructor(address _summerToken, address _accessManager, address _oracle) ProtocolAccessManaged(_accessManager);
```

#### createBond

Create a new bond contract for a solver


```solidity
function createBond(address solver) external onlyKeeper returns (address bondContract);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`bondContract`|`address`|Address of the created bond contract|

Get the bond contract for a solver


|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`address`|Address of the bond contract (address(0) if not created)|


#### hasBond

Check if a solver has a bond contract


```solidity
function hasBond(address solver) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if solver has a bond contract|


#### isSolverVouched

Check if a solver is vouched (has sufficient bond)

This function converts USD amount to SUMR token amount using oracle price

Formula: requiredAmount = (requiredBond * price) / 10^SUMMER_TOKEN_DECIMALS


```solidity
function isSolverVouched(address solver, uint256 requiredBond) external view returns (bool);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|
|`requiredBond`|`uint256`|Required bond amount in USD (18 decimals)|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`bool`|True if solver is vouched with sufficient bond|


### Events
#### BondCreated
Emitted when a new bond contract is created for a solver


```solidity
event BondCreated(address indexed solver, address indexed bondContract);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|
|`bondContract`|`address`|Address of the created bond contract|

#### BondRemoved


**Parameters**

|`solver`|`address`|Address of the solver|

Emitted when a new oracle address is set


**Parameters**

|----|----|-----------|
|`oracle`|`address`|Address of the new oracle|

### Errors
#### IntentBondFactory__InvalidSolver
Thrown when the solver address is invalid


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__InvalidSolver();
```

#### IntentBondFactory__BondAlreadyExists
Thrown when attempting to create a bond contract that already exists


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__BondAlreadyExists();
```

#### IntentBondFactory__BondNotFound
Thrown when the bond contract for a solver cannot be found


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__BondNotFound();
```

#### IntentBondFactory__IntentHandlerAlreadySet
Thrown when attempting to set the intent handler address after it has already been set


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__IntentHandlerAlreadySet();
```

#### IntentBondFactory__NotIntentHandler
Thrown when a caller is not the authorized IntentHandler contract


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__NotIntentHandler();
```

#### IntentBondFactory__InvalidAddress
Thrown when an input address parameters is invalid (e.g. zero address)


```solidity
error IntentBondFactory__InvalidAddress(string message);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`message`|`string`|Reason describing why the address is invalid|
